requests.theme: distressed-debt/AMC (NPL-NPA asset management) — BAM buys and works out non-performing loans/assets on its own balance sheet — closest existing tag alt-asset-mgmt describes third-party fund managers (PE/credit/real-asset LPs), not an AMC recovering distressed bank debt; assigned alt-asset-mgmt as closest fit but the economics differ

automated/unmanned vending-kiosk retail (robotic beverage vending, e.g. เต่าบิน BOYA) — no existing slug fits: specialty-retail and convenience-store both imply staffed physical stores, restaurant-chain's desc is a staffed restaurant/cafe chain — BOYA's fully unmanned kiosk network is a distinct format/economics and is arguably FORTH's most name-recognized growth driver, currently untagged

cinema/leisure-entertainment complex operator — Major Cineplex's core business is movie-theater exhibition plus bowling/karaoke/ski venues and in-cinema ad media, monetized via ticket/concession/venue traffic — no slug covers theater exhibition; media-streaming (content production/distribution/publishing) is the closest existing tag but describes a content owner-distributor, not a venue operator screening others' films

stem-cell banking / cell & gene therapy services — Medeze's core business is long-term storage (banking) of stem cells for individuals plus cell & gene therapy services — no slug covers biobanking; assigned healthcare-services as the closest fit, but that theme's own examples (dialysis, home health) describe recurring clinical care, not a storage-contract business model

out-of-home / billboard-transit advertising — ธุรกิจหลักคือป้ายบิลบอร์ด-สื่อขนส่งมวลชนแบบออฟไลน์ ไม่มี tag ตรงในคลัง digital-advertising ที่ใช้แทนนิยามเฉพาะ "แพลตฟอร์มซื้อขายโฆษณาออนไลน์" ซึ่งไม่ตรงกับโมเดล OOH physical media

เอนเตอร์เทนเมิร์ซ / D2C commerce ควบสื่อ (TV shopping + ผลิตภัณฑ์ความงามแบรนด์ตัวเอง) — ขาธุรกิจ Lifestar TV Shopping และ ULife ไม่ใช่ marketplace ออนไลน์ (ecommerce-platform) และไม่ใช่ร้านค้าเฉพาะทางแบบมีหน้าร้าน (specialty-retail) จึงติดเฉพาะ media-streaming ให้ธุรกิจฝั่งคอนเทนต์ ส่วนขาคอมเมิร์ซยังไม่มี tag ที่ตรง

private education / international school — no theme in vocab for K-12/international-school tuition-fee businesses; closest available is thai-consumption (domestic/expat household fee spend), but there is no business-theme slug for schools

metal/pressure-vessel fabrication for export — LPG cylinder manufacturing is a steel fabricated-goods exporter — not raw metal mining (industrial-metals), not machinery (industrial-machinery is closest but imperfect), not consumer packaging (packaging-materials ties to consumption/ecommerce volume, wrong economics)

spa / wellness services — Let's Relax-style spa and massage chains have no business-theme slug; dental-aesthetic and healthcare-services both describe clinical services, not relaxation/wellness retail; only the thai-tourism driver honestly applies

eyewear/ophthalmic-lens export manufacturing — optical-photonics is scoped to AI/network optical components (transceivers, CPO), not vision lenses; medical-devices used as closest fit but eyewear lenses are not implants/treatment devices — no theme covers precision optical lens mfg for export

out-of-home / transit advertising — digital-advertising's desc is scoped to online ad platforms; VGI's core business is physical OOH media on BTS trains and stations, not online adtech — used digital-advertising as closest via its generic "โฆษณา" alias

aircraft-leasing-finance — AerCap is a pure aircraft/engine lessor-financier — no manufacturing, MRO, or flight operations, so neither aerospace-supply (parts/engines/MRO desc) nor airline-travel (operator desc) is an exact fit; aerospace-supply used as closest since AerCap sits inside that value chain and its desc explicitly names engines

public-safety-tech — TASER/body-camera hardware ผูกกับ Axon Evidence/Records SaaS สำหรับหน่วยงานความปลอดภัยสาธารณะ — cloud-software คลุมได้แค่ฝั่งซอฟต์แวร์ ไม่คลุมฮาร์ดแวร์อาวุธช็อตไฟฟ้า/กล้อง; defense-rearm หมายถึงวัฏจักรอาวุธยุทโธปกรณ์ทางทหาร ไม่ใช่อุปกรณ์บังคับใช้กฎหมายในประเทศ

commercial real estate services / brokerage — CBRE is a leasing & capital-markets brokerage plus outsourced facility/project management (GWS) — no tag in the vocab covers real estate services firms (vs REIT owners); closest available, staffing-business-services, captures the contract-fee model but not the real-estate-specific business

vehicle-auction-marketplace — Online salvage/total-loss vehicle auction platform for insurers and dealers, not general retail commerce — ecommerce-platform is the nearest existing slug but is framed around consumer/general marketplaces

ai-cloud-compute-provider — Company IS the AI GPU cloud/datacenter operator (neocloud, GPU-as-a-Service), not a supplier benefiting from buildout elsewhere — ai-datacenter's own desc frames it around beneficiaries of AI cluster building, and no business-side tag exists for operating cloud compute infrastructure distinct from cloud-software (enterprise SaaS)

on-demand delivery / local-commerce marketplace — DoorDash's core model is delivery logistics aggregating restaurants/retailers to consumers, not a goods marketplace; ecommerce-platform is the closest existing slug but describes buying/selling goods online, not delivery-as-a-service

industrial/engine filtration — Donaldson is a pure-play filtration equipment and consumables maker (engine, industrial, life-sciences air/fluid filtration); industrial-machinery is the closest existing slug but doesn't capture the aftermarket-consumables filtration business model

theme-park & resort operator — Disney Experiences (parks, resorts, cruise line — a large share of Disney's operating profit) has no matching theme; media-streaming only covers the content/DTC/studio side of the business

mortgage insurance (financial guaranty on residential mortgage default risk) — insurance-pc assumes underwriting-based P&C/reinsurance risk; PMI protects lenders against borrower default, a distinct risk class with no dedicated slug, so insurance-pc is used only as the closest available

pure-fee M&A and restructuring advisory boutique with zero balance-sheet risk — global-bank fits only via the alias "investment bank" but its desc assumes lending, capital markets, and wealth management together; Evercore does none of that, just advisory fees, and no boutique-advisory slug exists

general engineering and scientific consulting with forensic litigation support — it-services covers IT-specific consulting and system integration; Exponent's failure-analysis and expert-witness work across biomedical, civil, electrical, and mechanical engineering has no matching slug

insurance management company on an attorney-in-fact fee model with zero underwriting risk — insurance-pc assumes the tagged company underwrites P&C risk directly; Erie Indemnity only earns a management fee on Erie Insurance Exchange's premiums and carries no underwriting risk itself

title-insurance — insurance-pc นิยามผูกกับวัฏจักรเบี้ยประกัน P&C ทั่วไป แต่ title insurance เป็นกรมธรรม์ครั้งเดียวผูกกับปริมาณธุรกรรมอสังหาฯ/จำนอง ไม่มีธีมเฉพาะให้ใช้ ใช้ insurance-pc เป็นตัวใกล้สุดที่มี

independent advisory investment bank (no lending/trading book — M&A + restructuring fees only) — global-bank's desc is lending + capital markets + wealth management; HLI has none of that, it's pure fee advisory. Used global-bank as closest since its alias list literally includes "investment bank" / "วาณิชธนกิจ", but a boutique-advisory theme would be more honest.

specialty/electrical trade contractor (installs power infra for data centers, commercial, residential — not heavy civil works) — infrastructure-construction's desc is civil works and large government projects; IESC does electrical contracting for private commercial/data-center/residential clients, a different animal. Used it as closest fit.

records/information management services (physical document storage + shredding + digital, still majority of revenue) — No slug covers this service business. Approximated with reit-office-selfstorage for the storage-space angle, paired with reit-datacenter-tower for the explicitly named, fast-growing data-center REIT segment (Project Matterhorn).

electronic test & measurement instruments (general-purpose T&M, not fab-process equipment) — Keysight makes oscilloscopes/network analyzers/optical test gear used broadly (RF, aerospace, telecom, AI optics validation) — closest existing slug semi-equipment-eda only fits its metrology alias loosely; no vocab entry for standalone T&M instrument makers

consumer-health / OTC drugstore brands (Tylenol, Band-Aid style) — portfolio spans OTC pain relief (Tylenol), oral care (Listerine), wound care (Band-Aid) and skincare (Neutrogena) — beauty-personalcare covers the skincare piece but not the OTC-medicine identity of Tylenol/Band-Aid; no pharma-branded fit either since these are consumer OTC, not Rx pipeline products

live-entertainment-ticketing — concert promotion + ticketing platform (Live Nation/Ticketmaster) has no matching slug; media-streaming is the closest but its scope is content production/distribution, which Live Nation doesn't do

diversified-industrial-manufacturer — one integrated operating company spanning abrasives/adhesives/safety (Safety & Industrial) + electronic materials/connectors (Transportation & Electronics) — not a sum-of-parts holdco so holding-conglomerate's holdco definition doesn't fit, and no existing tag covers a diversified multi-segment industrial manufacturer; specialty-chemicals used as closest tag (fits the adhesives/tapes/abrasives custom-formula angle)
safety-equipment (PPE/gas detection/SCBA/fall protection) — ไม่มีธีมผู้ผลิตอุปกรณ์นิรภัยอุตสาหกรรม ใช้ industrial-machinery เป็นตัวใกล้เคียงที่สุด
public-safety-tech (LMR radio/video security/emergency command software) — ไม่มีธีมเทคโนโลยี public-safety ใช้ networking-gear เป็นตัวใกล้เคียงที่สุด

elevator-escalator-equipment (OEM + recurring maintenance service) — no vocab theme covers vertical-transportation equipment makers; building-products (decor/hardware for buildings) is the closest available but its named examples are doors/windows/locks, not mechanical building systems — used as best fit

off-price retail — ไม่มีธีมค้าปลีกที่ครอบคลุมโมเดล off-price/treasure-hunt (Ross Dress for Less) — retail-bigbox เน้น home-improvement/grocery, specialty-retail เน้นร้านเฉพาะกลุ่ม ใช้ specialty-retail เป็นตัวใกล้สุดแต่ไม่ตรงเป๊ะ

death-care / funeral-cemetery services — Funeral homes, cemeteries, preneed contracts have no analog in the vocab; staffing-business-services (recurring contracted services) is the least-wrong stand-in but doesn't capture the death-care model.

sterilization / infection-prevention services — STERIS's core (hospital instrument reprocessing, contract sterilization for pharma/biotech) is a service line, not an implant or treatment device; medical-devices is the closest available but only partially honest.

custody / asset-servicing bank — State Street's primary business (#2 global custodian, ~$46T AUC/A, securities lending, FX) is asset servicing/custody banking, distinct from both wealth-asset-mgmt (fits only the SSGA/SPDR slice) and global-bank (implies lending); no clean fit exists.

foodservice-distribution — Sysco's core business is national foodservice distribution (restaurants, hospitals, schools, hotels) built on cold-chain logistics scale — industrial-distribution is the closest available slug but is framed around industrial/IT/consumer goods middlemen, not perishable food distribution

diversified scientific/defense-electronics instrumentation — Teledyne is a serial-acquirer spanning digital imaging sensors, defense/aerospace electronics, and marine/environmental instruments — no vocab tag covers multi-vertical precision instrumentation conglomerates; used electrical-components as closest (sensor overlap) though its auto/data-center framing doesn't match Teledyne's actual end markets

geospatial/positioning technology — Trimble's core product is GPS/positioning hardware plus workflow software sold across construction, precision agriculture, and land survey — no vocab tag exists for positioning/navigation tech; used electrical-components as closest available match

ride-hailing/delivery aggregator platform — no slug for gig-economy mobility marketplaces; internet-platform is closest but its desc/aliases (search, social) skew toward ad-funded platforms, not a rides/delivery take-rate marketplace

testing/inspection/certification (TIC) services — UL Solutions' core business (product safety labs, EV battery/renewable testing, certification) has no home; staffing-business-services (recurring contracted inspection) is the closest analogue but names different specific services
equipment rental — industrial-machinery fits the asset class (construction/aerial/specialty equipment) but the vocab has no rental-model business tag distinct from equipment manufacturing

gaming/experiential REIT — casino-gaming describes an operator whose revenue depends on gamblers; VICI is a triple-net landlord collecting rent from casino operators — no REIT tag covers gaming/experiential real estate

domain registry / core internet infrastructure — internet-platform (search/social, ad- or engagement-driven) is the closest available but VeriSign's monopoly registry-fee model is structurally different

senior housing REIT — reit-healthcare-lab covers Ventas's Medical Office & Research segment but not its largest segment (SHOP senior housing), which is neither standard residential nor medical/lab real estate

rail equipment / rolling stock manufacturing — industrial-machinery is the closest general fit; railroad-freight describes network operators/railcar lessors, not locomotive/braking-system manufacturers

product quality & marking/ID systems — water-infrastructure covers the Hach/ChemTreat/Trojan water-quality segment (~majority of revenue) but not the Product Quality & Innovation segment (Videojet/Esko/X-Rite/Pantone marking, color, and inspection systems)
